tool.name: similarity-generic
tool.scope_note: WITHIN-FILE pairs only: 0.5.0's directory walk fails on Windows (os error 5, dir opened as file — demonstrated 2026-08-14), so the tool runs per file; its per-file output carries function names without line spans, matched to ce units by name (generous credit, documented)

method: denominator = every pair the pinned comparator reports at ITS OWN defaults over the pinned corpus tip (the tool's detectable set — a recall denominator and NEVER a precision oracle, DEDUP-CALIBRATION stance); the denominator never shrinks (decision ③ 归因不排除). credit = ce full-stack (决策③ 全层记功): a pair is DETECTED iff a ce T1/T2 dedup block pair (t=50 winnowing default) or a T3 clone judgment (is_clone, θ=85/100) overlaps BOTH sides by >=1 line (either orientation); cobra resolves tool names to unit spans first. misses carry a closed attribution vocabulary: no_unit (no ce unit overlaps a side), below_floor (a side's unit has < T3_MIN_NODES=24 nodes — the registered short-unit domain bound), size_bound_not_clone (best-case similarity min(nodes)/max(nodes) < 85/100 under ce's registered TSED — mathematically impossible to clear θ), judged_not_clone (sent through the real TED, refused at θ=85/100). [method-text amendment 2026-08-17: the first freeze described the pre-S5 vocabulary ('not_reported_clone … not separable from the product report') which the S5 exhaustive candidate source had already made separable — the ROWS always carried the shipped vocabulary; this sentence now matches them. rows/summary/attribution untouched.] recall_raw = detected/denominator; recall_incremental = t3-credited / (denominator - t1t2-credited), trigger <0.50 = written disposition (§9.4). Coverage list: ripgrep EXCLUDED (similarity-rs is '(future)' per similarity-generic --supported, 0.5.0); self EXCLUDED (its covered-language slice is crosscheck fixture data the product walk excludes by ce.toml).
